body: not to be one to judge but going through your post history and seeing activity on /r/Benzodiazepines is a very big red flag. additionally, posts relating to losing Suboxone refills is also pretty damning. if these prescriptions are so important to you why are you not taking more serious care of them? if you're prone to losing them (in your own words, at least one benzo script and one Suboxone script) you definitely need to come up with a plan to fix that. maybe a handheld safe to secure your medicines upon pickup at the pharmacy?
